hooks.name: Run vitest after spec task
hooks.description: Runs the vitest suite after any spec task is marked complete, matching the "run after every change" convention.

action.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/node/node-v24.22.1-darwin-arm64/bin:$PATH"; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)" && npm test
